Burner modelled as a single 0.30 m x 0.20 m rectangle (0.06 m²), so HRRPUA = 62.9/0.06 ≈ 1048 kW/m². This matches the reference Steckler value of 1048.3 kW/m².
Fire set to 'constant' (62.9 kW from t = 0 s) as requested. No time_to_peak_s or hrr_curve is set.

Fuel is methane (CH4, heat of combustion 50 000 kJ/kg, CO yield 0) because the Steckler tests used a methane burner. The schema requires soot yield to be above 0, so it is set to 0.001 instead of the reference value of 0.
The wall and floor use the default INERT surface. The fibre-board insulation lining from the reference case is not modelled.
The downstream wall is the 0.10 m thick obstruction the user specified, not the generic 0.2 m default.
Uniform mesh of 0.10 m as specified, giving 36 x 28 x about 21 cells (z = 2.13 m is not a multiple of 0.10 m, so the ceiling is snapped to the nearest cell).
Output intervals use the defaults: DT_DEVC = 1 s, DT_SLCF = 5 s.
Ambient temperature uses the FDS default (20 °C). The reference case used 25 °C, but the user did not state a value.
Thresholds profile uses the default fr_default; RSET = 120 s on the escape path.
